cues: Sixteen years later, Avery, MacLeod and McCarty repeated it in test tubes and destroyed one kind of molecule at a time.
Destroy the protein: transformation still happens.
Destroy the RNA: it still happens.
Destroy the DNA, with DNase, and it stops.
text: Sixteen years later, Avery, MacLeod and McCarty repeated it in test tubes and destroyed one kind of molecule at a time. Destroy the protein: transformation still happens. Destroy the RNA: it still happens. Destroy the DNA, with DNase, and it stops. The transforming principle was DNA.
